CHALLENGE 3: "WHERE DID THE MONEY GO?"
Corvid Robotics Internal Hackathon, November 2026

THE PROBLEM
Our finance team reconciles roughly 900 supplier invoices a month by hand. Each one has to be matched against a purchase order and a goods-received note, and the totals rarely line up exactly: shipping is billed separately, currencies differ, and partial deliveries get invoiced in pieces. Today one analyst spends most of the last week of every month in spreadsheets chasing a few hundred euros of differences.

WHAT WE'RE ASKING YOU TO BUILD
A prototype that takes a folder of invoices (PDF or email), pulls out the vendor, line items and invoice total, and flags any invoice whose total doesn't match its PO within a tolerance the user can set.

WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE
- Correctly extracts totals from at least 8 of the 10 sample invoices we'll provide
- Explains *why* something was flagged, in plain language
- Runs on a laptop; no customer data leaves the building

JUDGING
Accuracy 40%, usefulness to a non-technical user 40%, demo 20%.
Teams of 2-4. Sample data will be shared at kickoff.
